checkinComingSoonBody: The next step of the check-in experience is ready to connect to the live reservation workflow.
checkoutComingSoonBody: This screen will handle final charges and room release.
servicesComingSoonBody: This area will route guests to hotel services and support.
servicesPageSubtitle: Request support, explore the hotel, or find your next destination at {{hotelName}}.
servicesSidebarCopy: Request support, explore amenities, and find your way around the hotel.
servicesRequestSectionSubtitle: Choose an option and we’ll show you the next step.
servicesRequestHousekeepingDescription: Ask for room cleaning or a refresh.
servicesRequestAmenitiesDescription: Request towels, toiletries, or extra pillows.
servicesRequestDiningDescription: Order something delicious for your room.
servicesRequestConciergeDescription: Get help with directions, plans, or anything else.
servicesRequestPanelCopy: A team member will receive this request and come back to you shortly.
servicesRequestError: We couldn’t validate or send the request. Check the room number and try again.
servicesRequestSuccessCopy: The team has been notified. Please remain available at your room.
servicesPlannerTitle: What kind of stay are you having?
servicesPlannerSubtitle: Choose a mood and we’ll turn it into a simple next step.
servicesMoodUnwindTitle: Make room for a quieter hour
servicesMoodUnwindDescription: Head to Spa & Wellness for a slower pace, assisted access, and a moment away from the lobby.
servicesMoodTasteDescription: Visit the main restaurant for breakfast, seasonal plates, and a relaxed dining room.
servicesMoodMoveDescription: The fitness center is open around the clock for training, stretching, or a quick reset.
servicesMoodDiscoverDescription: Take the scenic route to the rooftop pool and its panoramic view over the city.
servicesAmenitiesSubtitle: Check the details you need before heading out.
servicesBreakfastDescription: Enjoy an artisanal selection in our main dining room.
servicesPoolDescription: Located on the rooftop with panoramic city views.
servicesWellnessDescription: State-of-the-art equipment for your training routine.
servicesSupportDescription: Our team is available for any request.
servicesCheckoutDescription: For your convenience and the organization of new arrivals.
servicesSpotlightCopy: Our team can help with directions, local recommendations, and anything that makes your stay easier.
mapPageSubtitle: Navigate the neoclassical architecture of {{hotelName}} and discover our exclusive spaces.
mapRouteActiveCopy: Follow the moving gold line to {{destination}}. About {{eta}} from reception.
mapRouteCopy: Follow the highlighted path from reception to {{destination}}.
mapReceptionDescription: Guest starting point and the primary reference for internal guidance.
mapSpaDescription: Wellness area with treatments, relaxation rooms, and assisted access.
mapRestaurantDescription: Dining space for breakfast and seasonal experiences.
mapWellnessDescription: Workout room with equipment and a stretching area.
mapPoolDescription: Panoramic pool with lounge, sun deck, and city views.
mapRoomsDescription: Suites and rooms distributed across the hotel’s main floors.
mapAccessibleRoute: Step-free access is available for this route.
mapReceptionStepOne: You are already in the arrival hall, beside the reception desk.
mapReceptionStepTwo: The concierge and main entrance are directly ahead.
mapSpaStepOne: Cross the lobby toward the central lift core.
mapSpaStepThree: Exit toward the west wing; Spa & Wellness is directly ahead.
mapRestaurantStepOne: Follow the lobby corridor toward the dining hall.
mapRestaurantStepTwo: The restaurant entrance is on the left, beside the inner garden.
mapWellnessStepOne: Follow the lobby corridor toward the dining hall.
mapWellnessStepTwo: Continue past the restaurant and take the short ramp to Level 1.
mapWellnessStepThree: The fitness studio is on the right, opposite the courtyard.
mapPoolStepOne: Cross the lobby toward the central lift core.
mapPoolStepTwo: Take the lift to the rooftop.
mapPoolStepThree: Turn left for the sky deck; the pool entrance is straight ahead.
mapRoomsStepOne: Cross the lobby toward the central lift core.
mapRoomsStepTwo: Select your room floor in the lift.
mapRoomsStepThree: Exit toward the east guest wing and follow the room signs.
